name: Queen Azshara
guide_text: It's worth buying the highest attack units in your shop and pointy arrows to complete your quest ASAP. You ideally want this quest done turn 6 the latest. Then, start leveling and force a Naga comp.
buddy_guide_text: Best when paired with Deep blue Zesty comp, but even so pretty mediocre.
